mapper.select: select userdata.username as username, permissionsdata.password as password, permissionsdata.use_permissions as permissions, userdata.created_date as created_date, userdata.updated_date as updated_date from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata" userdata inner join "interviewworks_schema".permissionsdata permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username where userdata.username = #{username} order by userdata.updated_date desc

select userdata_details.username as username, permissionsdata.password as password, permissionsdata.use_permissions as permissions, userdata_details.created_date as created_date, userdata_details.updated_date as updated_date, userdata_details.order_item as order_item from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details" userdata_details inner join "interviewworks_schema"."userdata" userdata on userdata_details.username = userdata.username inner join "interviewworks_schema"."permissionsdata" permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username where userdata_details.username = #{username} and userdata_details.is_active = '0' order by userdata_details.updated_date desc

select concat('(', permissionsdata.use_permissions, ')', userdata.username, ' 銷售代號', userdata_details.order_item) as fixed from "interviewworks_schema".userdata userdata inner join "interviewworks_schema"."permissionsdata" permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username inner join "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details" userdata_details on userdata.username = userdata_details.username where permissionsdata.use_permissions in ('GUEST', 'USER') and userdata_details.is_active = '1' and userdata_details.tracking_number is null order by case permissionsdata.use_permissions when 'GUEST' then 1 when 'USER' then 2 end , permissionsdata.updated_date desc

select quotations.quotation_id, quotations.username, quotations.status, quotations.total_price from "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations where quotations.quotation_id = #{quotation_id} and quotations.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: insert into "interviewworks_schema"."orders" ( order_id, quotation_id, status, total_price) values (#{order_id}, #{quotation_id}, #{status}, #{total_price})
mapper.select: select quotations.quotation_id, quotations.status, quotation_items.quantity, quotation_items.price, quotation_items.quantity * quotation_items.price as sum_price, products.products_name, products.description from "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotation_items" quotation_items on quotations.quotation_id = quotation_items.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."products" products on quotation_items.product_id = products.product_id where quotations.quotation_id = #{quotation_id} and quotations.username = #{username}
